about: Trees from the Ministry of Culture Heritage Trees lists for Sukhothai province that are not published.

leads.name: Tamarind, Moo 7 Ban Na Klang
leads.source: Ministry of Culture Heritage Trees 2019 list (th.wikipedia)
leads.note: 2019 list: name and province only, no coordinate, figures or site. No photo or exact pin in reach.

leads.name: Ton Tan 3 Yot, Ban Dok Chan
leads.species: Unclear: name says toddy palm (tan), register mapped to Diospyros (chan)
leads.source: Ministry of Culture Heritage Trees 2019 list (th.wikipedia)
leads.note: 2019 list: name and province only. Species mapping in register is doubtful (tan is a palm, chan an ebony). No pin, no photo.

blocked.name: Giant Chorakhe durian, Ban Huai Tum, Si Satchanalai
blocked.reason: Private family orchard (Thai Post 2018-09-10, farmed by the owner's family); register flags private care; 2018 article gives age about 108 years, no access terms, no dated life check. Not shipped unless a source shows public access.
